goal: Give generated projects explicit planning, source, test, build, distribution, and deployment boundaries outside the harness.

alignment.evidence: PR #1 is merged; this second slice targets a focused project-lifecycle branch from the new main.
The destination command, project-type layouts, ignore rules, current memory, and generated WordPress tree were inspected.
The slice scaffolds and documents project lifecycle ownership; it does not package, deploy, merge, or release.
The harness is the factory, each project is the working root, src is canonical code, build is disposable, and dist is delivery output.
One type-aware scaffold extends the existing zero-dependency destination command without adding a build system.
Generated directories have single responsibilities, WordPress packaging rules are explicit, and project guidance travels with the scaffold.
Seven behavioural tests, control verification, a real temporary WordPress scaffold, and filesystem inspection passed on 2026-08-01.
